findings.title: API docs still describe the old 4-round review limit
findings.detail: Review.maxRounds is now 2 (Engine/Review.swift), and this PR adds new Review fields (branch, blocking, followUps) and the follow-up-review/blocking-vs-worth-doing-later split, but docs/runner-api.md wasn't updated: it still says "round 1 to 4" (line 135), "At most 4 reviews per job; when the fourth requests changes..." (line 138), "review 4" in the inbox table (lines 140, 157, 463), and documents neither the new `branch`/`blocking`/`followUps` fields on the review object nor the "Follow-ups from Oby's review:" report section. Clients reading this spec (or developers maintaining it) will be misled about the current round limit and the new follow-up/blocking behavior this change introduces.
